items.headline: $XMR1 Crashes 99% After $13M Wagyu Hack
items.summary: Wagyu's wrapped Monero token $XMR1 plunged 99% after an attacker dumped tokens in a $13M exploit. The founder pledged to personally refund affected users.

items.headline: $ZRO Staking Goes Live Nov. 23 Ahead of Zero
items.summary: LayerZero set Nov. 23 for $ZRO staking ahead of its Zero launch. Rewards come from new issuance with no early exit; unstaking expected by March 2027.

items.headline: $ASTER Blames Coordinated Trades for Price Chaos
items.summary: $ASTER says coordinated trades caused its mark-price divergence, forcing its insurance fund to take over positions. A safeguards review is announced but no compensation plan yet.

items.headline: $QI's BENQI Plans Queue to Cut sAVAX Unstake Waits
items.summary: BENQI is planning a new queue to shorten sAVAX unstaking waits on Avalanche. Pending requests carry over without losing waited time, and holders won't need to move tokens.

items.headline: $PI Hits Record Low After First Pi Summit
items.summary: $PI slid about 26% in a week to a record low, far outpacing bitcoin's 11% drop, even as Pi Network unveiled developer incentives and mainnet trading tool plans.
